note: A DRAFT FOR THE ANALYST'S REVIEW. Nothing here is a grade until he has answered the sheet. `drafted` records rest on an opened source and are exactly what would be written if accepted. `recommended` entries are the drafting agent's own estimates with no source opened; an accepted one is written as a practitioner grade.

reason: Sixth of fourteen markets on hold IRR, 7.5%.
持有期IRR为7.5%，在十四个市场中排名第六。
96% of first-year revenue is secured for fifteen years under a representative long-term auction award; the payment is derived from costs and is not an identified contract price.
在代表性的长期拍卖中标情景下，首年收入的96%锁定十五年；该付款金额由成本推算，并非已确认的合同价格。
The network company publishes its connection process, a cap of eight concurrent connection studies per operator, and its payment terms for the construction-cost contribution.
电网公司公布了并网流程、每家运营商同时进行的并网研究不得超过八项的上限，以及工程费负担金的付款条款。
Connection studies are rationed at eight per operator from August 2026, in the area with the most output control: fifty days in the first quarter of 2026.
自2026年8月起，并网研究按每家运营商八项的上限受理；该区域出力抑制最为频繁：2026年第一季度达五十天。

A foreign investor must file a prior notification before taking any share of an unlisted company in the electricity sector; an exemption exists for investors who take no part in management, and not for state-owned ones.
外国投资者在取得电力行业非上市公司任何股份之前须事先申报；不参与经营管理的投资者可获豁免，但国有企业不适用该豁免。
The long-term auction's terms are reset each round, including the price ceiling for batteries; awards already made keep their terms.
长期拍卖的条款每轮都会调整，包括电池的价格上限；已授予的合同条款不变。

capitalAtRisk.why: A first payment of half the connection charge at the connection contract, and no deposit rule recorded. No amount is published.

timeToRevenue.why: As Tokyo: study, contract and a six-hour build. Level with Great Britain and Germany (3).

saturation.why: The area with the deepest solar surplus has drawn the most battery interest relative to its size. Between Tokyo and Hokkaido.

scaleRepeatability.why: A mid-sized area with export limited by one interconnector; two to four more reference projects is my estimate.

supplyChainOrigin.why: The finance ministry's outline lists storage batteries as a designated sector and the decision profile names sourcing compliance as a gate for the long-term auction. I read that as an origin or security rule conditioning an auction, which is 3; if it bars a supplier from the main revenue route outright it is 2. Not established by a source I opened.

demandGrowth.why: National supply plans show roughly flat demand with data-centre and semiconductor load as the upside. Level with Great Britain and Western Australia (3) in all three areas.

debtAvailability.why: Domestic banks lend against the twenty-year auction award, and merchant financings are few. A step under Great Britain and Germany (5). National, so the same in all three areas.

exitLiquidity.why: Development-stage projects change hands; few operating storage assets have traded. Level with Finland (3). National.

revenueCertainty: The decision profile says the modelled award payment is cost-derived and not an identified price. The grade follows the engine's figures, as the anchor asks; a project without an award secures nothing.
foreignEntry: The finance ministry's outline for investee companies, dated May 2023, was opened. It states no review period, which the anchor's grade 4 wants at 90 days or less; I recall a thirty-day waiting period and did not source it. National, so the same in all three areas.
approvalTransparency: From the register's entries for the network company, which it holds as verified. The Tokyo notice refused the fetch on 2026-10-12, so none was re-opened.
capitalAtRisk: No item in the ledger has an amount: the payments are percentages of a connection charge that is not published.
